781c3dec: ;
 .;This routine is used to update the ATTENDING PHYSICIAN and PRIMARY/
 .;SECONDARY PHYSICIAN fields in the HOSPITAL MOVEMENT (#393) file.
 .;
 .;It is called from the input transform of the ATTENDING PHYSICIAN and
 .;PRIMARY/SECONDARY PHYSICIAN fields and sets up the variables for the
 .;FileMan call to edit these fields.
159bedca: ;Call DE (setup variables) and jump to label BEGIN
59434c43: ;Initialize variables for FileMan
b7e2ab0a: ;If data exists in 0 node, set DE(1) to internal value of ATTENDING PHYSICIAN
91919228: ;Kill utility nodes and quit
fbffe670: ;Write data label and colon
7c29fd1b: ;Quit
cbe7919a: ;Call W (write data label), write external value, wrap if >45 chars
7d6fbeb2: ;If external value >19 chars, if DV does not contain I, and if DV contains F or K, call RW^DIR2
5bdaec7c: ;If ext value exists, write //. If DV doesn't contain I and DV contains I, if DE(DQ) exists and is odd, set X to null and write '(No Editing)'
1ca3b2f0: ;Read value into X, set DTOUT=U if timeout, write * and beep if timeout or '^' entered
35bf903a: ;Quit
08bd12a9: ;Increment DQ and kill data for this record
9946587b: ;Branch to label corresponding to value of DQ
0d01a48a: ;If DE(DQ) exists, go to PR label, else write label and read value

50895619: If the input is blank, go to the next question for prompts that don't allow null responses, exit for prompts that do allow null responses, or continue processing if the data type is not required.
daa3181c: If the user enters a question mark, go to the help section.
51c48cc8: If the user enters an at symbol, go to the FileMan entry point for adding new entries.
e02abbba: If the user enters a space and a default response is available, use that default response (unless the prompt is DATE or SET OF CODES).

8cd49484: If the prompt has a specific data type validation, continue processing accordingly. If it's a SET OF CODES data type, look up the code description and display it. If there's an input transform, execute it.
cc920a0e: If the user's response matches one of the selections in the SET OF CODES, return that selection.
4a143940: If the user's response doesn't match any SET OF CODES selection, display the remainder of the selection list and use the input as the new response.
2d1482a3: If it's a POINTER data type, look up the entry in the pointed-to file and allow the user to choose or edit it.
b1cf57a0: If it's a NUMBER data type and the number is too long, reject it.
5f2a69d2: If it's a NUMBER data type, remove any trailing zeros after the decimal point.
970d3e41: Execute any CROSS-REFERENCE input transform on the user's response.
4f8eaffa: If the response is acceptable, update the database and word-processing fields with the new value.
57425930: If the response is unacceptable, print a bad response message.
e207765c: Set the internal entry value to ?BAD to indicate an unacceptable response.
09f073d4: If the user enters a question mark followed by other characters, go to the question mark help.
8669272d: ;D builds the data for the DIR utility.

07728907: ;If DE(DQ) is undefined, the variable X is set to the external form of the data. If DV does not contain 'R' and X is equal to '@', or if DV contains 'R' and X is not equal to '@', control is transferred to the 'N' label. Otherwise, control is transferred to the 'RD' label.
796f790f: ;If DV contains a 'P' and there is a value in DQ(DQ,2), that value is executed. Otherwise, control is transferred to the 'RP' label.

57bae196: ;If DV contains a 'P' and the file pointed to by X has data in the 0 node, X is set to the value in the second piece of the 0 node. If the cross-referenced entry in the 'Y' node does not exist, control is transferred to the 'RP' label. Otherwise, Y is set to the value in the first piece of the 0 node, X is set to the value in the third piece of the .01 field of the file pointed to by X, and DG is set to the value in the second piece of the 0 node. Control is then transferred to the 'R' label.

f4ea3da3: ;If DV contains a 'V' and Y is a number, and the second piece of Y contains parentheses and the global node pointed to by that piece has data in the 0 node, X is set to the value in the second piece of the 0 node. If the entry in the 'Y' node does not exist, control is transferred to the 'RP' label. Otherwise, Y is set to the value in the first piece of the 0 node. If the .01 field of the file pointed to by X has data, DG is set to the value in the second piece of that data, and X is set to the value in the third piece. Control is then transferred to the 'R' label.
00148e4c: ;If DG contains a 'D', the ^DD('DD') routine is executed. If DG contains an 'S', and the second piece of the 'X' string separated by ';' and 'Y' contains a value, Y is set to that value.
1fff5af9: ;If X is null, X is set to the value of DE(DQ). If DV is null or DC is less than 2, control is transferred to the 'A' label. Otherwise, control is transferred to the 'N^DIE17' label.
80424bae: ;If DV does not contain an 'I' or a '#', control is transferred to the 'RD' label.
a963509c: ;The ^DIE0 routine is executed, and if X is defined, control is transferred to the 'RD' label. Otherwise, control is transferred to the 'PR' label.
